visualCharacteristics: Full-bleed rotating hero slides; each slide has a background photo with a dark gradient overlay, a large white heading, and a single green CTA button aligned to the lower-left. Slide indicator dots at the bottom.
contentPattern: One row per slide. Each row has two cells: cell 1 = background image, cell 2 = heading + optional body + CTA link.
usage: Top-of-page promotional slideshow rotating multiple full-width banner slides.
